name: Prisoner's Dilemma
oracle_text:
Each opponent secretly chooses silence or snitch, then the choices are revealed. If each opponent chose silence, Prisoner's Dilemma deals 4 damage to each of them. If each opponent chose snitch, Prisoner's Dilemma deals 8 damage to each of them. Otherwise, Prisoner's Dilemma deals 12 damage to each opponent who chose silence.
Flashback {5}{R}{R}
blocked_sentences: Each opponent secretly chooses silence or snitch, then the choices are revealed. If each opponent chose silence, Prisoner's Dilemma deals 4 damage to each of them. If each opponent chose snitch, Prisoner's Dilemma deals 8 damage to each of them. Otherwise, Prisoner's Dilemma deals 12 damage to each opponent who chose silence.

needs.what: a decision where each opponent secretly and simultaneously chooses one of two named options (silence or snitch), all choices revealed together and bound per player under an `as`, so that (a) a condition can ask whether every opponent chose a given option ('each opponent chose silence' / 'each opponent chose snitch') and (b) a player selector can pick out the opponents who chose a given option ('each opponent who chose silence') for a damage op
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_mode has a `chooser`, but wrapping it in for_each_player over opponents makes the choices sequential and public, so later opponents see earlier choices, which changes the card; set_flag/has_flag could mark each chooser but condition_keys has no 'every opponent has flag' aggregate and no player selector filters opponents by a recorded choice. The sibling gap expert_level_safe files the same secret_choice need for numbers
